mapper.select: SELECT t1.*,user.userName FROM `url` AS t1 JOIN (SELECT ROUND(RAND() * (SELECT MAX(id) FROM `url`)) AS id) AS t2 LEFT JOIN user ON t1.userId=user.id WHERE t1.id >= t2.id and t1.isShare=1 ORDER BY t1.id ASC LIMIT #{limit};

SELECT url.*,COUNT(likes.urlId) AS COUNT ,user.userName FROM likes LEFT JOIN url ON likes.urlId=url.id LEFT JOIN user ON url.userId=user.id WHERE likes.state=1 and url.isShare=1 GROUP BY likes.urlId ORDER BY COUNT DESC

select url.*,user.userName from url LEFT JOIN user on url.userId=user.id where url.label like #{keyword}
and isShare=1

select url.*,user.userName from url LEFT JOIN user on url.userId=user.id where 1=1 and url.isShare=1
and url.userId in
${followUserId}
and url.userId=-1
order by url.createTime DESC
SELECT url.*,user.userName FROM likes LEFT JOIN url ON likes.urlId=url.id LEFT JOIN user ON url.userId=user.id WHERE likes.userId=#{userId} and state=#{state} and url.isShare=1
SELECT url.*,user.userName FROM likes LEFT JOIN url ON likes.urlId=url.id LEFT JOIN user ON url.userId=user.id WHERE likes.likesUserId=#{likesUserId} and state=#{state} and url.isShare=1
